title.zh: 完整本地化课程目录界面

purpose.en: Remove the English fallback from the twelve-language course directory and learning-path planner while preserving the selected site language on every deep link.
purpose.zh: 移除十二语言课程目录与学习路径规划器的英文回退，并让每个深层链接保持用户选择的网站语言。

en: Translate the course-directory hero, planner controls, skill names, durations, availability states, and action labels in all twelve site languages.
Translate the selected-language course detail, tier names, package features, pricing units, and subscription actions instead of reverting to English after a catalog click.
Use one shared static interface catalog so future planner copy is reviewable and testable.
zh: 以十二种网站语言翻译课程目录首屏、规划器控件、技能名称、时长、可用状态及操作标签。
翻译选定语言后的课程详情、等级名称、方案功能、价格单位和订阅操作，避免点击目录后重新回退英文。
使用同一份静态界面目录，让后续规划器文案可审查、可测试。

en: Course directory, selected-language course details, and learning-path planner in all twelve site languages
zh: 十二种网站语言下的课程目录、选定语言课程详情与学习路径规划器

en: Replace the bilingual page guard and English fallback with the shared twelve-language locale contract.
Localize planner shell text and bilingual course metadata through the static interface catalog.
Use each learning language's authoritative native name on its course detail instead of an ambiguous machine-translated demonym.
Expand the translation-catalog maintenance script and add regression assertions for the deep course route.
zh: 以共享十二语言区域契约替换双语页面守卫及英文回退。
通过静态界面目录本地化规划器外壳文案与双语课程元数据。
在课程详情使用学习语言的权威原生名称，避免含义不清的机器翻译族称。
扩展翻译目录维护脚本，并为课程深层路由增加回归断言。

en: Run TypeScript, route-language, header, learning-community, and language-consistency contracts plus the production build.
Deploy, verify the exact Project release record, and use real Chrome to traverse the Japanese and Korean course-directory flows.
zh: 执行 TypeScript、路由语言、页头、学习社区、语言一致性契约及生产构建。
部署并核验 Project 精确发布记录，再用真实 Chrome 走查日语与韩语课程目录流程。

en: Learner-authored course data remains displayed as authored; this release localizes the platform interface and built-in planner content.
zh: 学员自行创建的课程数据仍按原文显示；本次发布本地化平台界面与内置规划器内容。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's twelve target-language courses, five-skill learning model, anonymous trial, SmartCards, Sprint, and reward-point isolation.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 十二目标语言课程、五项技能学习模式、匿名试学、智慧卡、速成及积分隔离。
